_meta.definition: The process of managing employee compensation data, including payroll processing and salary history.

HumanResources EmployeePayHistory._description: Tracks historical changes in employee salaries, rates, and pay frequencies over time.

columns.name: BusinessEntityID
columns.description: Foreign key linking to the Business Entity entity

columns.name: RateChangeDate
columns.description: Stores historical dates of employee pay rate changes.

columns.name: Rate
columns.description: Stores historical hourly wages for employees.

columns.name: PayFrequency
columns.description: Stores the frequency of employee pay periods (e.g., biweekly represented as 2).

columns.name: ModifiedDate
columns.description: Stores a series of identical date strings (YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss.fff) for multiple pay history modifications on June 30, 2014.
